Software Engineer — Platform

About the role
We are hiring a mid-level Software Engineer to build APIs and internal tools that power our product. You will work closely with product and design.

Responsibilities
- Design and implement REST APIs in TypeScript/Node.js
- Own features end-to-end from design review to production
- Improve reliability, observability, and developer experience
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident reviews

Requirements (must have)
- 3+ years professional software engineering experience
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js
- Experience designing REST APIs and relational data models (PostgreSQL)
- Comfortable with Git, code review, and CI/CD basics
- Clear written and verbal communication

Nice to have
- GraphQL
- Experience with Redis or message queues
- Prior startup experience

Location: Remote (US time zones preferred)

Backend Engineer

We need a Backend Engineer who can scale data-heavy services.

Must have:
- 5+ years Python experience
- Strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query performance)
- Experience with distributed systems (queues, retries, idempotency)
- Familiarity with Docker and cloud deployments

Preferred:
- Kubernetes
- Kafka or similar event streaming
- Experience with Python async frameworks (FastAPI/asyncio)

You will collaborate with data science and infrastructure teams to ship reliable batch and real-time pipelines.

Short JD.
Build features.
Ship fast.

Frontend Engineer

Must know React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Required: accessibility (WCAG) knowledge and component-driven UI.
Behavioral: stakeholder communication and design collaboration.
Nice to have: Next.js and Storybook.

You will own customer-facing UI for our dashboard product.

Full-Stack Engineer

Must have:
- TypeScript
- React
- Node.js
- System design fundamentals
- CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar)
- Automated testing (unit + integration)

Required domain experience:
- Building multi-tenant SaaS features
- AuthN/AuthZ patterns (sessions/JWT/RBAC)

Preferred:
- AWS (ECS or Lambda)
- Observability (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar)
- Experience mentoring juniors

This role blends product feature work with reliability improvements.

Senior Frontend Engineer

Join our product engineering team to craft high-quality web experiences.

What you'll do
- Build performant React interfaces with strong UX polish
- Partner with designers on interaction details and accessibility
- Improve frontend architecture, testing, and bundle performance

Must-haves
- Expert React and TypeScript
- Deep understanding of browser performance and accessibility
- Experience with design systems / component libraries
- Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor others

Nice-to-haves
- Next.js App Router
- Experience with animation and complex forms
- GraphQL clients (Apollo/urql)

Interview process includes a UI take-home and a system design conversation focused on frontend architecture.

Product Manager — Growth

We are looking for a Product Manager to own activation and retention experiments.

Responsibilities
- Define problem statements and success metrics
- Run A/B tests and interpret results with data partners
- Write crisp PRDs and align engineering/design stakeholders
- Present roadmap tradeoffs to leadership

Must have
- 4+ years product management experience in B2B or consumer SaaS
- Strong analytical skills (SQL preferred)
- Excellent stakeholder communication and prioritization
- Experience shipping experiments end-to-end

Nice to have
- Prior growth or monetization ownership
- Familiarity with Amplitude/Mixpanel
- Technical background sufficient to discuss API constraints

Behavioral focus: conflict resolution, ambiguous problem framing, and customer empathy.

Site Reliability Engineer

Own reliability for customer-facing services.

Required
- Production experience with Linux systems and networking basics
- Infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent)
- Observability: metrics, logs, traces, SLOs/error budgets
- Incident response and blameless postmortems
- Scripting in Python or Go

Preferred
- Kubernetes in production
- Chaos engineering or load testing practice
- Multi-cloud experience

You will partner with application teams to improve deploy safety and reduce MTTR.

Machine Learning Engineer

Build and productionize ML features for search and recommendations.

Must have
- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
- Experience training and evaluating ML models
- Familiarity with feature pipelines and offline/online evaluation
- Ability to collaborate with product on metric definitions

Required technical skills
- SQL and data warehousing concepts
- Experience deploying models behind APIs or batch jobs

Nice to have
- PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Vector search / embeddings
- Experience with LLM application patterns (RAG, evaluation harnesses)

Seniority: Mid to Senior. Location: Hybrid.

Junior Software Engineer (New Grad)

We hire curious engineers who learn quickly and write clear code.

Requirements
- CS degree or equivalent practical experience
- Comfortable with at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java)
- Understanding of data structures and algorithms basics
- Willingness to ask questions and accept feedback

You will
- Ship small features with mentorship
- Write tests and documentation
- Participate in code review

Preferred
- Internship experience
- Side projects or open-source contributions
- Exposure to web development or APIs

This case is meant to exercise a longer prep window with a lighter JD.
